text:
Hello! I'm Hana, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. It's good to finally meet you here.

- **Web app** — web: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate, and then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **My own messengers** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Tell me if you'd like that.
- **My own accounts** — I can sign up on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages, and talk by voice.

Also: ok. What would you like to start with?

On it: I've written to all five TAs with candidate slots for the CSE455 staff meeting next week (Mon 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 13:00-13:30). I'll book the slot everyone can take and log it.
